entry.title: Cefalù Cathedral

terrainReference.basis: Standard DEM datum 33.867381m; estimated architectural floor0.5m relative to this datum, rather than lifting the full cathedral above the coarse rear/Rocca hill. Raw main perimeter spans -8.43..11.00m. Lower wall foundations follow terrain; the front stair flight is an estimated transition. Coarse DEM can conceal lower eastern/southern foundation surfaces. Exact thresholds, terrain cut/fill, absolute altitude and certified walking unverified; no independent survey or terrain flattening.
